description: Source code for SparkConnectClient class and related utilities, implementing a client for Spark Connect protocol with gRPC communication, plan compression, artifact management, and session handling.

classes.name: SparkConnectClient
classes.description: Client for Spark Connect protocol, managing session, plan execution, artifact upload, and configuration.

classes.name: PlanCompressionOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for plan compression, including threshold and algorithm.

classes.name: SparkConnectClient.Configuration
classes.description: Configuration parameters for SparkConnectClient, including host, port, security, and user agent.

classes.name: SparkConnectClient.AccessTokenCallCredentials
classes.description: gRPC CallCredentials implementation for access token authentication.

classes.name: SparkConnectClient.MetadataHeaderClientInterceptor
classes.description: gRPC client interceptor to add custom headers to requests.

methods.name: analyze
methods.description: Dispatches an analyze plan request to the server and returns the response.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a plan and returns a closeable iterator over responses.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Sends a configuration request to the server.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Clones the client session with optional new session ID.

methods.name: addArtifact
methods.description: Adds an artifact (file or in-memory bytes) to the session.
